hypothesis: Post-09:30 EMA pullback/reversal shorts underperform because a large subset are triggered during unstable post-open price discovery where the alert candle’s high-low range (and thus stop_distance_pct, since stop is the alert opposite extreme) is large, indicating poor liquidity/resiliency and higher adverse selection. Imposing a max_stop_distance_pct gate for non-09:30 entries will disproportionately remove stop_loss exits and lift profit_factor and median_expectancy of the remaining non-09:30 trades.
mechanism: Microstructure research (temporary liquidity imbalance and bid–ask bounce) implies the tradable reversal component is short-lived and sensitive to liquidity/resiliency; in our strategy, the entire risk unit is defined mechanically by the alert candle’s range (entry at alert extreme; stop at opposite extreme). Large stop_distance_pct post-09:30 is therefore a direct proxy for unstable/noisy conditions where reversal-followthrough is less reliable and stop-outs dominate. Implement a post-09:30-only max_stop_distance_pct filter inside strategy.py (the same stage that applies other entry filters) so that signals with excessive alert-bar range are rejected with a dedicated reason; keep 09:30 untouched to preserve the core edge.

expected_effects.rationale: Removing the widest-risk, most stop-out-prone post-09:30 trades should reduce gross losses more than gross profits, improving PF while keeping the 09:30 edge intact.
If wide-risk trades are adversely selected, filtering them should shift the remaining post-09:30 trade distribution upward, raising median expectancy.

disqualifiers.name: trade_count_collapse
disqualifiers.condition: trade_count decreases by more than 30 percent versus require_alert_close_below_ema_for_non0930_shorts (N=1147)

disqualifiers.name: no_post0930_quality_gain
disqualifiers.condition: For post-09:30 trades with N>=300 after filtering, median_expectancy does not improve by at least 0.001 versus the latest restoration run’s non-09:30 median_expectancy (-0.000964)

stop_distance_pct distribution for rejected vs accepted post-09:30 signals
